appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Renewable Energy Production by Source'.
Y-axis is scaled from 0 to 70, with major tick marks at intervals of 5.
The bar for 'Solar' is yellow and has the value '41.2%' labeled above it.
The bar for 'Wind' is light blue and has the value '29.8%' labeled above it.
The bar for 'Hydroelectric' is blue and has the value '18.5%' labeled above it.
The bar for 'Biomass' is green and has the value '7.2%' labeled above it.
The bar for 'Geothermal' is brown and has the value '3.3%' labeled above it.

printed_facts.fact: Solar contributes 41.2% of renewable energy production.
Wind contributes 29.8% of renewable energy production.
Hydroelectric contributes 18.5% of renewable energy production.
Biomass contributes 7.2% of renewable energy production.
Geothermal contributes 3.3% of renewable energy production.

public_definitions: The goal is to identify the largest renewable generation contribution source and route that source record to priority contribution follow-up.
The chart is titled 'Renewable Energy Production by Source' and displays contribution percentages for five sources.

The primary field label is 'Priority contribution route' with three options: 'Route Solar for priority contribution follow-up', 'Route Wind for priority contribution follow-up', and 'Keep Hydroelectric on routine contribution monitoring'.
